authorization_rule: Run the prospectively frozen v0.7 training-only private-strength profiling diagnostic exactly once on the two already failed development panels. Reproduce the existing raw transfer statistic, estimate nuisance strength only from training species, select exactly two private configurations by the frozen robust-distance rule without using held-out transfer, use independent reference partitions for profiling and calibration, and preserve the result regardless of sign.
if_development_passes: Do not open birds or butterflies. First prospectively broaden the private nuisance family across transition width and boundary offset, as required by the frozen v0.7 rule.
if_development_fails: Select no v0.7 candidate, preserve the failure, and do not open birds, butterflies, or the RGFCA reserve.
